_README: The project's rate card of record for pricing Gemini API usage (PI ruling D18, 2026-09-21).
One entry per model; each entry lists dated rows. A row applies to usage whose date falls in
[valid_from, valid_to] (valid_to null = open). Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens by service
tier: standard (list), flex (real-time flex), batch (the async Batch API). Three usage classes
are priced separately: input_fresh (prompt tokens not served from cache), input_cached
(cache-read tokens; the API's prompt_token_count INCLUDES these, so callers subtract), and
output (candidates PLUS thinking tokens, which Google bills at the output rate). Cache storage
is per 1,000,000 tokens per hour and is tier-invariant.
Every row cites its published source and, where the project's own invoices confirm a rate,
the SKU, month and measured USD per 1M (reports/billing/gemini-spend-by-sku.csv). A row with
invoice_confirmations: [] is published-only; scripts/check_published_rates.py compares the
card with the pricing page and flags any difference for the PI to confirm in AI Studio or the
Cloud Console before this file is edited. Never edit a rate here without that confirmation.
The cache read is NOT the same at every tier for every model: Gemini 3 Flash Preview bills it
at the standard rate on flex and batch (invoiced US$0.0500/M, no tier suffix, 2026-03/04/08);
Gemini 3.7 Flash bills it at half on flex (invoiced US$0.0378/M, 2026-08). This is the
distinction the earlier hand-typed cards missed.

source.note: Output price includes thinking tokens. Context caching price under the Batch and Flex blocks reads 'Same as Standard' ($0.05 text / image / video); reports/token-load-audit-2026-06-12.md section 2.
